name: Marqly
tagline: The AI bookmark manager — save once, find it instantly

pricing.notes: Free tier needs no card and stores up to 2,000 bookmarks with search across your whole library; every AI feature is Pro — auto-tagging, summaries, semantic search, AI Q&A over saves and video chat.

pros: Semantic search finds saves by meaning — describe what you remember, no exact titles needed
AI tags and summarizes every save automatically, so nothing needs manual filing
YouTube AI card puts summaries, transcript, and Q&A right on the watch page
Highlights in 6 colors persist on the page itself and sync to your library
Screen-faithful save-as-PDF handled locally in the browser
One-click imports from Pocket, Raindrop, and browser bookmark files
cons: Free tier stores up to 2,000 bookmarks (without AI); unlimited bookmarks and all AI capabilities require Pro
No AI at all on the free tier — auto-tagging, summaries, semantic search and chat are all Pro
Lifetime plans (AppSumo, 2022-24) save, browse and search without limit, but include no AI
No Android app yet (the web app works in Android browsers)
No public API or self-hosting option
bestFor: Anyone who saves more than they can organize — researchers, students, and heavy readers who want to find things again by describing them.
verdict: The strongest pick when finding saves again matters more than filing them.
overview: Marqly is an AI bookmark manager built around a browser extension for Chrome, Edge, Firefox, and Safari, plus a web app and an iOS app. On Pro, every save is tagged and summarized automatically and semantic search retrieves a bookmark by describing what you remember instead of matching exact keywords; the free tier is the manual half — saving, boards, highlights and keyword search. On YouTube, an AI card next to the player adds a streaming summary, a playback-synced transcript, and transcript-grounded chat. A built-in highlighter marks up any website in six colors with notes that persist across visits, boards collect links and highlights into shareable public pages, and any page can be captured as a clean PDF locally in the browser. Imports from Pocket, Raindrop, and standard browser bookmark exports make switching quick. A free tier requires no card and stores up to 2,000 bookmarks with search across your whole library; Pro lifts that cap to unlimited and adds full AI capabilities for $72/year (with $39 first-year offer) or $9/month with a 7-day trial.
